svg.text: A U-channel 8 deep x 12 tall with 1.5 mm walls, open toward the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shell: 261 mm along the back face, turning 26 mm along each end face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print in three pieces (back run and two corners) and glue them.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: lay the battery and sensor leads along the back face 6 to 18 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: up, then glue the cover over them with silicone along both edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each end turns into the notch in its housing's back wall.
